name: tabglutton
description: Devour duplicate tabs and save the keepers into Obsidian. For Zen Browser and Firefox.

scripts.build: bun run build:firefox && bun run build:chrome
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:ext && bun run typecheck:gullet
scripts.lint:ext: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext lint --source-dir=dist-firefox
scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:ext
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.start: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist-firefox --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:console: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist-firefox --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:fresh: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist-firefox --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen
scripts.start:fresh:console: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist-firefox --firefox=/Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen --browser-console
scripts.start:firefox: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext run --source-dir=dist-firefox --firefox-profile=./.dev-profile-firefox --profile-create-if-missing --keep-profile-changes
scripts.start:chrome: bun run build:chrome && bunx web-ext run --target=chromium --source-dir=dist-chrome --chromium-profile=./.dev-profile-chrome --keep-profile-changes
scripts.package: bun run package:firefox && bun run package:chrome && bun scripts/package-source.ts
scripts.package:firefox: bun run build:firefox && bunx web-ext build --source-dir=dist-firefox --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --filename=tabglutton-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: bun run build:chrome && bunx web-ext build --source-dir=dist-chrome --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --filename=tabglutton-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
